raw_segments.text: Shall we follow our old plan, which we adopted with a view to clearness, of taking the state
first and then proceeding to the individual, and begin with the government of honor?
I know of no name for such a government other than Timocracy, or perhaps Timarchy.
We will compare with this the like character in the individual, and after that, consider
Oligarchy and the Oligarchical Man, and then again we will turn our attention to Democracy
And lastly, we will go and view the City of Tyranny, and once more take a look into the
tyrant's soul, and try to arrive at a satisfactory decision.
